lens: validity, reliability, fairness, and evaluation design

findings.observation: The five-second and fact-versus-action constructs, atomic pass criteria, sample size, and 9/10 rule are frozen, but no human result exists.
findings.evidence: human-test/protocol.md predeclares the procedure and human-test/status.json reports 0/10 completed.
findings.user_impact: Any claim that first-use users understand the direction would currently be unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Run the predeclared protocol, retain verbatim answers, use two scorers, and report the exact numerator and denominator.
findings.verification: Both independently scored gates reach at least 9/10 with disagreements adjudicated from frozen responses.

findings.observation: The current review panel is one Codex run applying five explicit lenses, not five independent human or model graders and not a calibrated gold-set exercise.
findings.evidence: reviews/panel.json labels the review method and does not claim reviewer independence.
findings.user_impact: Correlated reviewer blind spots could make design confidence look broader than it is.
findings.recommendation: Use the specialist packets as bounded design review and keep human comprehension and release safety gates independent.
findings.verification: Human study results and any later model-judge panels report rater identity, agreement, order/repeat checks, and adjudication separately.

strengths: The product ranks work attention, not candidate worth, fit, personality, potential, responsiveness, or acceptance probability.
Fact, interpretation, action authority, and observed outcome remain separate evaluation units.
Ambiguity, insufficient evidence, and no-action preserve abstention rather than forcing a score.
missing_evidence: Ten human comprehension records with independent scoring agreement.
Independent calibrated reviewers or a human gold set for any broader model-evaluation claim.
open_questions: What human-study population will be used to support generalization beyond the initial boutique-recruiter wedge?
